question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Start from scratch

options.text: Start it from the previous situation
Start something fast to finish it before a particular time

solution: The correct answer is: **Start entirely from the beginning ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom "**Start from scratch**" means to begin from a point at which nothing has been done yet. (शुरुआत से शुरू करें) • Example - *Nothing like this had ever been done before, so we had to start from scratch__.* • So, it is clear that the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom "**Start from scratch**" is "**Start entirely from the beginning**" Hence, the correct answer is option 4. 3c:T142e,
